newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the panhandle area Wednesday. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 lower, USDA said.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 25,500 slaughter steers and 15,400 heifers; 61,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 11,600 formulated and 800 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00, few North Plains 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 68.50-69.50.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 69.50 to mostly 70.00, pen North Plains 71.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00-69.50.
Wk to Date: 61,100 Week Ago: 63,500 Year Ago: 39,600
